title: Deer Visit Pattern vs Moon Phase
dataSources: Bird acoustic detections (`birdnet:detection`), wildlife-camera visits (`wildlifecam:visit`), nest-box state (`nestbox:event`), frog-call activity (`frogcall:detection`), and pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`).
app: Wildlife telemetry from BirdNET, trail and feeder cameras, nest-box sensors, frog-call detectors, and pollinator counters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, APIs, and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wildlifecam:visit species="deer"
| stats count as visits by moon_phase
| sort - visits
description: Counts deer visits by moon phase to test whether local activity really changes with brighter nights.
value: Moon-phase lore is common in wildlife hobbies, and this view gives you a grounded way to test it at home.
implementation: Enrich trail-camera detections with moon phase from a local almanac or astronomy library.
visualization: Bar chart of deer visit count by moon phase.
grandmaExplanation: It warns whether deer come through more often under certain moon phases in your area.
